results.question: How much did Nasdaq return to shareholders in 2025 through dividends paid and share repurchases combined?
results.logged: The total amount paid of $601 million was recorded in retained earnings in the Consolidated Balance Sheets at December 31, 2025, as dividends paid (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity). The total purchase price (in millions) — Year Ended December 31, 2025, was $616 million, as share repurchases (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity). Therefore, Nasdaq returned a total of $601 million + $616 million = $1,217 million to shareholders in 2025 through dividends paid and share repurchases combined.
